nodes.name: Authentication Service
nodes.description: Backend service that validates credentials, handles tokens, and manages sessions.
nodes.purpose:
Centralizes user authentication rules, password crypt operations,
and secure JWT session generation.
responsibilities: validates login credentials against database user records
generates secure JWT session tokens with proper expirations
handles token refresh and session revocation requests
capabilities: issues crytographically secure and signed tokens
invalidates active sessions upon logout request

nodes.name: Login UI Component
nodes.description: React-based frontend form that collects credentials and communicates with the backend.
nodes.purpose:
Collects user credentials, provides client-side sanitization,
and delegates secure calls to the backend API.
responsibilities: renders username and password input elements
submits user credentials to the authentication backend API
stores the returned JWT token securely in browser local storage
capabilities: handles form inputs and client-side validation
dispatches secure API requests to Backend
caches JWT token and hydrates session store

nodes.name: Backend Domain
nodes.description: Manages logic, databases, and authentication endpoints.
nodes.purpose:
Abstracts core transactional operations, security constraints,
and database persistence layers.

nodes.name: Frontend Domain
nodes.description: Handles the user interface and frontend components.
nodes.purpose:
Enforces boundaries and coordinates state synchronization between
web UI layers and microservice gateways.

nodes.name: Authentication Feature
nodes.description: Coordinates user login, JWT generation, and secure session management.
nodes.purpose:
Ensures secure credentials validation and cryptographically signed session tokens
across frontend and backend interfaces.
